description: This file defines an interface for asserting and verifying properties of JSON values within a testing or validation framework. It specifies method signatures for checking if a JSON value is of a certain type (array, object, boolean, null, number, string) and whether certain operations are unsupported.

classes.name: JsonValueAssertable
classes.description: An interface providing assertion methods for JSON values, enabling method chaining to verify JSON content types and properties.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is not an array.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is not an object.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNullLiteral
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is null.

methods.name: isNotNullLiteral
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is not null.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isNotNumber
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is not a number.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Asserts that the JSON value is not a string.

methods.name: doesNotSupport
methods.description: Asserts that invoking the given consumer method on the JSON value throws an UnsupportedOperationException.
